serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Goddammit! My head!
It’s getting pretty annoying…
After this phone call from mom it got even worse.
She just always has to add that little extra bit. I was sure I didn’t need any help or meds, but now I’m starting to doubt myself…
Parents should support their children, but all she can do is doubt my decisions and be overprotective... 
I hate that Blaubleim guy, he always acts so smug and asks the stupidest questions.
Mom thinks he’s a good doctor only because he was on television while advertising some antidepressant.
The same antidepressant that he prescribed me.
I’m sure he’s getting some percent of the money from the sales.
How can someone like that be trusted?
